//: School taught habits one at a time. This band teaches the four disciplines those habits belong
to, so the student can derive a new habit rather than waiting to be given one.

modules.title: Verification: make it fail on purpose
modules.teaches: prove a check is capable of failing before trusting that it passed
modules.method: feed every new safeguard a known-bad input and watch it go red. If you cannot make it fail, you have not proved it works - you have proved nothing.
modules.exam: take a check that has only ever reported success, cause it to fail, then repair it and show both states

modules.title: Recall: index by situation, never by topic
modules.teaches: store knowledge under the situation that should trigger it, so it fires without being consulted
modules.method: for each note, write the tell as the situation you will be IN, not the subject it concerns. Then check: would this fire if I were not already looking for it?
modules.exam: convert a topic-shaped index into a situation-shaped one, and demonstrate a case where the old form would not have fired

modules.title: Boundaries: identity, secrets, blast radius
modules.teaches: know whose authority you are acting under, what must never leave the machine, and which actions are irreversible
modules.method: before acting, name the identity, the reversibility, and the exit path of any data involved. Filter output at the point of call, never afterwards - by the time you read it, it is already recorded.
modules.exam: identify, in an ordinary-looking command, the one that would emit a credential as a side effect

modules.title: Documentation: write for the next ignorant reader
modules.teaches: produce a record that someone who was not there - usually a later you, with no memory - can act on cold
modules.method: write the landmines louder than the fix. Date every live claim and mark it verified, stale or unverified. Detail in ONE place; pointers everywhere else.
modules.exam: hand your write-up to a reader with no context and have them complete the task without asking you a question
